entities.name: Sidelink RRC reconfiguration
entities.description: Procedure for reconfiguring sidelink radio resources and parameters between UEs.

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationSidelink
entities.description: RRC message used to reconfigure sidelink parameters and resources.

entities.name: Sidelink configuration
entities.description: Information element containing sidelink resource allocation and transmission parameters.

relations.description: The sidelink RRC reconfiguration procedure involves transmission of RRCReconfigurationSidelink message.
The RRCReconfigurationSidelink message contains sidelink configuration information elements.
The procedure establishes new sidelink configuration parameters in the UE.
